dataset.note: Reference-corpus shape-distance analysis, not a claim of live iPhone end-to-end success or a general OCR accuracy estimate. Split unit is source filename; the corpus contains repeated and near-duplicate shapes across filenames. Label duplicates/confusions are rejected by runner-up margin. The local live screenshot was not used for prototype selection.

nativeFontFallback.source: CoreText-rendered on the local OS, cached once; uses the same RGBA context ordering, glyph segmentation and normalization as captured images
nativeFontFallback.priority: Never replaces an accepted reference-bank match; all three independent stricter shape conditions must pass
nativeFontFallback.marginCalibration: 0.03 accepts genuine macOS-font round letters whose nearest neighbour is another round letter (measured Helvetica-Bold O 0.0165 distance / 0.0376 margin, system heavy O 0.0166 / 0.0345) while the distance and 2x-relative gates keep every rejected held-out reference sample rejected

selection: Reserve every fifth segmentable example per label (one for labels with <=5). Greedy farthest-point selection of up to 24 training examples per label starting at nearest-to-mean; deduplicate exact normalized records. Exclude the three demonstrably mislabeled prototype records documented below rather than relabeling them or relaxing acceptance thresholds. No live screenshot used in prototype selection.
